absences.note: No rule decides which pending evidence item is reviewed next at any snapshot. Checked: evidence item index/listing endpoints (S1-S2 evidence_items_controller index ordered by id with optional status filter; S2 curation_dashboard_controller evidence_items_requiring_action lists submitted items ordered by id asc, display only), v2 resolvers (top_level_evidence_items sort options chosen by the viewer), moderation mutations (accept any item in any order), schema (no priority/queue column). Ordering is presentational and not enforced.

No assignment, reviewer, owner or due-date field on evidence_items in db/schema.rb / structure.sql at any snapshot; no assignment logic in policies, controllers, mutations or jobs. Any eligible moderator/editor may act on any item. Notifications to subscribers and @role mentions (S2+: NotifyMentioned / CaptureMentionsAndNotify notify all users with a mentioned role) are user-initiated notices, not assignment.

Human-initiated exits exist: S1 soft delete by moderator (K17); S2 soft delete by editor and submitter self-withdrawal via reject (K16, K17); S3-S4 submitter self-withdrawal (K16). No timer-based exit at any snapshot: no expiry field, no TTL, and no scheduled task or background job writes evidence-item status (checked S1 self-rescheduling jobs, S2 config/scheduled_tasks.yml, S3 empty scheduled_tasks.yml, S4 scheduled_tasks.yml incl. FindRetractedSources, which only adds/resolves flags, and FlagDuplicateAlleleRegistryIds, which flags variants). If only automatic exits count, the answer is false at all four snapshots.

notes: Scope: server layers read at each snapshot were routes, controllers/concerns, Pundit policies (S1-S2), GraphQL mutations ready?/authorized? (S3-S4), Actions/Activities, model validations and callbacks, validators, admin consoles (ActiveAdmin S1-S2, Trestle S3-S4), jobs and scheduled task config. Client (C) checks could only be assessed for S3-S4 because civic-server has no client code; C entries are marked false for S1-S2 for that reason. Uncertainties: (1) K24 auto-resolution of retraction flags references an undefined local variable 'text' in resolve_eid_flags, so it probably raises whenever an open flag exists; recorded as present code. (2) At S3, Mutations::RejectRevisions#ready? does not return true on the ids branch (it returns the revisions array), which with graphql-ruby's ready? semantics likely makes rejecting two or more revisions by id fail; fixed at S4. (3) At S2 the ActiveAdmin suggested-change approve/reject actions call apply/close with an outdated arity and would raise; not counted as separate controls. (4) S2 source-curation status (submitted/partially curated/fully curated/exhausted) is a status on Source, not on SourceSuggestion; I coded those side effects under source_suggestion because they drive the source suggestion queue. (5) Admin-console status edits (K21) are coded P because they enable admins to bypass API checks; the admin consoles are restricted to admins at all snapshots. (6) Deprecation guards in S4 (cannot deprecate variants/MPs/diseases/therapies/sources linked to submitted or accepted evidence items or open revisions) were judged entity-maintenance rules rather than review controls and are not coded. (7) In S3-S4 the server allows a submitter to withdraw (reject) their own evidence item, but the S3 client hides the reject button from non-editors; covered under K8. (8) Role names: S1 curator<moderator<editor<admin; S2-S4 curator<editor<admin.
